patent.title: Secondary battery
patent.family_note: US counterpart of Asahi Kasei JP priority (1985-05-10) for a practical nonaqueous secondary battery combining layered composite-oxide cathode chemistry with specified n-doped carbonaceous anode material. Package B early ledger uses grant-date T0 only; Sony 1991 commercial Li-ion and later phone/EV LIB success are excluded from this historical state. Related Goodenough LCO platform patent US4302518A (1981) is used only as pre-T0 cathode-chemistry context.

knowledge_origin.description: Public patent record identifies Asahi Kasei industrial R&D inventorship (Yoshino / Sanechika / Nakajima) and corporate ownership of the practical nonaqueous secondary-battery architecture.

technology.problem: Prior secondary batteries (lead-acid, NiCd) were hard to miniaturize; metallic-lithium and early intercalation / doping approaches lacked practical cyclicity, self-discharge, and/or safe high-energy-density nonaqueous cell architectures for small electronics.
technology.mechanism: Nonaqueous secondary battery using (I) layered composite oxide A_xM_yN_zO2 and/or (II) n-doped carbonaceous material within specified BET / crystallite-thickness / density windows as electrode active material — enabling reversible Li+ intercalation/doping without metallic-lithium anode dependence in the preferred embodiment.
technology.comparison_baseline: Lead-acid and NiCd practical secondary batteries; metallic-lithium nonaqueous cells; earlier intercalation cathodes (e.g., TiS2) and LCO cathode science without a matched practical carbonaceous-anode cell architecture.

value_carriers.name: Small/light nonaqueous Li-ion secondary-battery platform (aspirational at T0; no marketed carrier confirmed)
value_carriers.description: Pre-T0 LCO cathode science and the 1987 patent's lab/prototype cell examples demonstrate a practical rechargeable architecture, but at T0=1987-05-26 no public exact-patent mapping to a marketed consumer Li-ion battery is used in this ledger.

gaps.description: At T0=1987-05-26 there is no confirmed exact-patent → marketed Li-ion consumer / EV battery carrier link in this ledger. Lab/prototype cell performance and claimed secondary-battery uses are not implemented as a public commercial carrier here.
needed_evidence: license / supply schedule tying this grant to a marketed battery

gaps.description: No public T0 evidence attributes royalty, incremental battery revenue, or cost/performance economics to this exact patent.

V0.7 can record R0 plus electrochemical / materials differentiation, but has no structured field for early option/future-value horizon that is decision-relevant precisely when realization is still R0/R1.
needed_evidence: explicit separation of option signals from realized R-stage

notes: Package B early-stage option retrospective #3 (energy-storage / materials; diversifies beyond mRNA life science and OLED organic display). T0=grant date 1987-05-26 stops at R0: Asahi Kasei industrial patent + Goodenough/Mizushima LCO cathode platform (MRB 1980 / US4302518) + patent lab/prototype option signals exist, but no marketed exact-patent carrier is recorded. Sony 1991 commercial Li-ion, later phone/laptop/EV LIB success, and licensing narratives are post-T0 and must not be backfilled into this ledger.
